([[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]]) | college = [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]] (2020–2021) | highlights = * First-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2021) * SEC All-Freshman Team (2021) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2020) | medal_templates = }} '''Cameron Thomas''' (born October 13, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU Tigers]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the best [[shooting guards]] in the 2020 class. He finished his high school career at Oak Hill Academy in [[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]]. ==High school career== As a freshman, Thomas began playing basketball for [[Oscar F. Smith High School]] in [[Chesapeake, Virginia]].{{cite web |last1=Brown |first1=Mitch |title=Oscar Smith eyeing a state title game return with the help of a fantastic freshman |url=https://www.wtkr.com/2017/02/10/oscar-smith-eyeing-a-state-title-game-return-with-the-help-of-a-fantastic-freshman |publisher=[[WTKR]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=February 10, 2017}} He did not play in his sophomore season because he and his mother "weren't on the same page" as the team's coaching staff.{{cite web |last1=Teel |first1=David |title=Cam Thomas having breakout spring for Boo Williams team |url=https://www.dailypress.com/sports/dp-spt-cam-thomas-eybl-0530-story.html |website=[[Daily Press (Virginia)|Daily Press]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=May 29, 2018}} For his junior season, he transferred to [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] in [[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]], where he joined [[Cole Anthony]] and [[Kofi Cockburn]] in one of the most touted teams in the country.{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=Preseason Top 25 High School Basketball Rankings: No. 2 Oak Hill Academy |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/ihqcMcu7H0SCq-7KRvt4fQ/preseason-top-25-high-school-basketball-rankings--no-2-oak-hill-academy.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=October 17, 2018}} Thomas averaged a team-high 26.2 points, 3.8 rebounds and 3.4 assists per game, leading his team to a 31–5 record.{{cite web |last1=Hayes |first1=Tim |title=Thomas, Robinson among the stars for Oak Hill Academy Warriors |url=https://www.heraldcourier.com/sports/thomas-robinson-among-the-stars-for-oak-hill-academy-warriors/article_213f5ccc-f08b-11e9-a0d8-0b27003db54d.html |website=[[Bristol Herald Courier]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=October 16, 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=2018-19 MaxPreps Boys Basketball Junior All-American Team |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/Unx8d7lBbEmJkCDKNtEhCw/2018-19-maxpreps-boys-basketball-junior-all-american-team.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=April 17, 2019}} In July 2019, he was named Offensive Player in the Year in the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] after averaging a league-best 29.5 points per game for Boo Williams.{{cite web |last1=Pope IV |first1=Jonas |title=This five-star NC State basketball target named EYBL Offensive Player of the Year |url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/college/article232250077.html |website=[[The Charlotte Observer]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=July 3, 2019}} As a senior at Oak Hill, Thomas averaged 31.5 points, six rebounds and 3.4 assists per game, leaving as the program's all-time leading scorer.{{cite web |last1=West |first1=Glen |title=LSU Five-Star Guard Cam Thomas Named to Inaugural SI All-American Second-Team |url=https://www.si.com/college/lsu/basketball/cam-thomas-si-all-american |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=April 2, 2020}} Thomas posted 30-plus points in nine games, including two 40-point performances. He led his team to the Tournament of Champions title, where he was named [[most valuable player]].{{cite web |last1=Raymer |first1=Kai |title=Oak Hill claims fourth Bass Pro Tournament of Champions title |url=https://www.ozarkssportszone.com/2020/01/18/oak-hill-claims-fourth-bass-pro-tournament-of-champions-title/ |publisher=Ozarks Sports Zone |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=January 18, 2020}} Thomas was selected to play in the [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=Jordan Brand Classic Rosters Revealed |url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/jordan-brand-classic-2020-michael-jordan-chicago-cade-cunningham-jalen-green |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=February 14, 2020}} ===Recruiting=== On November 18, 2019, Thomas committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]]. He chose the Tigers over an offer from [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]], among others, after taking official visits to both schools.{{cite web |last1=Biancardi |first1=Paul |last2=Borzello |first2=Jeff |title=Five-star scorer Cameron Thomas commits to LSU |url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/28108481/five-star-scorer-cameron-thomas-commits-lsu |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=May 15, 2020 |date=November 18, 2019}} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2020}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Cameron Thomas | position = [[Shooting guard|SG]] | hometown = [[Chesapeake, Virginia|Chesapeake, VA]] | highschool = [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] (VA) | feet = 6 | inches = 3 | weight = 180 | 40 = | commitdate = November 18, 2019 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 93 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2020 | rivals ref title = LSU 2020 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2020 LSU Tigers Recruiting Class | rivals school = lsu | scout s = | espn schoolid = 99 | 247 overall = 25 | rivals overall = 27 | espn overall = 23 | accessdate = August 3, 2020 | bball = yes }} ==College career== In Thomas's college debut on November 26, 2020, he scored 27 points in a 94-81 win against [[SIU Edwardsville Cougars men's basketball|SIU Edwardsville]].{{cite news |title=LSU's Thomas scores 27 in collegiate debut |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401262506 |access-date=December 2, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 26, 2020}} Thomas led all freshman in scoring with 23.0 points per game, while also averaging 3.4 rebounds and 1.4 assists per game. He was named to the First Team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]].{{cite news |last1=Plain |first1=Megan |title=Chesapeake's Cam Thomas declares for NBA Draft after one season at LSU |url=https://www.wtkr.com/sports/chesapeakes-cam-thomas-declares-for-nba-draft-after-one-season-at-lsu |access-date=June 19, 2021 |work=WTKR |date=April 15, 2021}} Following the season, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last1=Guilbeau |first1=Glenn |title=LSU star Cameron Thomas declares for NBA Draft; Jalen Cook, Aundre Hyatt may transfer |url=https://www.theadvertiser.com/story/sports/college/lsu/2021/04/15/lsu-basketball-nba-draft-cameron-thomas/7218794002/ |access-date=June 19, 2021 |work=[[The Daily Advertiser (Lafayette, Louisiana)|The Daily Advertiser]] |date=April 15, 2021}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] | 29 || 29 || 34.0 || .406 || .325 || .882 || 3.4 || 1.4 || .9 || .2 || 23.0 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://lsusports.net/sports/mens-basketball/roster/cameron-thomas/24520 LSU Tigers bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/t/thomas-cameron.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Thomas, Cameron}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Virginia]] [[Category:LSU Tigers basketball players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Chesapeake, Virginia]]
